```{r}
#| include: false

## Projects page ("Night and Day" design): an intro band with a jump list,
## then one day band per group (Trials, Observational studies, Daily life
## studies, Other studies, then "Projects we collaborate on"), each a white
## card per project: name, status and years, then the project's Summary.
## Built from Pandoc markdown that the chunks below cat(); styles are in
## styles/bml.scss and styles/bml-projects.scss.
##
## Everything comes from the workbook's Projects sheet. The Summary text is
## shown as written there (fix wording in the workbook, not here), apart from
## links to retired websites, which are taken out below. The navbar's Projects
## menu (run_website.R) links to each project's heading id, projectAnchor(Name),
## and to the group headings (#collaborations): keep those ids.

## load packages and setup
source("package_setup.R", echo = FALSE)

projects <- read_excel(cvpath, sheet = "Projects")
projects <- as.data.table(projects)[nzchar(Summary) & !is.na(Summary)]

## Websites that no longer work. Studies' own websites close once a study
## ends, so their links are taken out of the Summary text at render time:
## a line that only points to one ("Find out more at the study website.",
## with its icon and line break) is dropped, and any other link to one is
## shown as plain text. Add an address here when a website goes down.
retiredUrls <- c(
  "https://cancope.weebly.com/",        # CanCope: study finished (2022), website closed
  "https://sleepcarestudy.weebly.com/", # SleepCare: study finished, website closing
  "http://repat.haifa.ac.il/en/"        # REPAT (University of Haifa): page not found
)

## the groups, in page order: the workbook's Type, the heading (the same
## words as the navbar menu), the heading id (kept from the old page) and a
## line about the group. Projects we collaborate on (Primary == 0) are one
## group whatever their Type.
groups <- list(
  list(type = "Trial", title = "Trials", id = "trials",
       about = "Studies that test whether a treatment or program helps people."),
  list(type = "Observational", title = "Observational studies", id = "observational-studies",
       about = "Studies that learn from people's experiences, without testing a treatment."),
  list(type = "Daily", title = "Daily life studies", id = "daily-life-studies",
       about = "Studies that follow sleep, stress, mood and activity day by day, as people go about their lives."),
  list(type = "Other", title = "Other studies", id = "other-studies",
       about = "Other research our lab leads, including programs of work that span several studies."),
  list(type = NA_character_, title = "Projects we collaborate on", id = "collaborations",
       about = "Studies led by other research teams, in which our lab is a partner.")
)

## a project of ours with a Type not listed above would not appear in any
## group, so it goes under Other studies (and the render log says so)
ourTypes <- na.omit(vapply(groups, `[[`, "", "type"))
odd <- projects[Primary == 1 & !Type %in% ourTypes, Name]
if (length(odd) > 0) {
  cat("projects.qmd: shown under Other studies (Type not ",
      paste(ourTypes, collapse = ", "), "): ", paste(odd, collapse = ", "), "\n",
      sep = "", file = stderr())
  projects[Primary == 1 & !Type %in% ourTypes, Type := "Other"]
}

## current projects first, then the most recently started (as in the menu)
projects <- projects[order(-Status, -Started)]

## ---- retired links ----
## an address as a regular expression that also matches it with http or
## https, with or without "www." and with or without a final "/"
urlPattern <- function(u) {
  core <- sub("/+$", "", sub("^https?://(www\\.)?", "", u))
  paste0("https?://(?:www\\.)?", gsub("([.?*+^$()\\[\\]{}|\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", core, perl = TRUE), "/?")
}

## the Summary without links to retired websites
dropRetired <- function(s) {
  icon <- '(?:\\{\\{<\\s*fa\\s[^>]*>\\}\\}|<span class="fa[^"]*"></span>|<i class="fa[^"]*"></i>)'
  for (u in vapply(retiredUrls, urlPattern, "")) {
    ## a line (after a line break, or at the start) holding only an icon, a
    ## few words, the link and a full stop: dropped, with its line break
    s <- gsub(sprintf('(^|\\n|<br\\s*/?>)[ \\t]*(?:%s)?[ \\t]*[^.\\n<\\[]{0,60}\\[[^]\\n]*\\]\\(%s\\)\\.?[ \\t]*(?:<br\\s*/?>[ \\t]*\\n?|\\n|$)',
                      icon, u), "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    ## any other link to it: its text only
    s <- gsub(sprintf("\\[([^]\\n]*)\\]\\(%s\\)", u), "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- gsub(sprintf('<a\\s[^>]*href="%s"[^>]*>(.*?)</a>', u), "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
  }
  ## no line break left dangling at the end
  sub("(?:\\s*<br\\s*/?>)+\\s*$", "", trimws(s), perl = TRUE)
}

## ---- a project's card ----
## years: "2020–2022", "2018" (started and ended the same year),
## "2020–present" (current); a completed project without an Ended year shows
## its start year only (and the render log says so)
yearsLabel <- function(start, end, current) {
  start <- if (is.na(start)) NA else as.integer(start)
  end <- if (is.na(end)) NA else as.integer(end)
  if (is.na(start)) return(if (current) "" else if (is.na(end)) "" else as.character(end))
  if (current) return(sprintf("%d\u2013present", start))
  if (is.na(end) || end == start) return(as.character(start))
  sprintf("%d\u2013%d", start, end)
}

missingEnd <- projects[Status == "Completed" & is.na(Ended), Name]
if (length(missingEnd) > 0) {
  cat("projects.qmd: completed without an Ended year (start year shown): ",
      paste(missingEnd, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "", file = stderr())
}

## status in words, as a pill: "Current" (filled) or "Completed"
statusPill <- function(status) {
  if (is.na(status) || !nzchar(status)) return("")
  sprintf("[%s]{.bml-project-status%s}", mdEscape(status),
          if (identical(status, "Current")) " .bml-project-current" else "")
}

projectMd <- function(r) {
  years <- yearsLabel(r$Started, r$Ended, identical(r$Status, "Current"))
  meta <- trimws(paste(statusPill(r$Status),
                       if (nzchar(years)) sprintf("[%s]{.bml-project-years}", years) else ""))
  sprintf('
::: {.bml-card .bml-project}
::: {.bml-project-head}
### %s {#%s}
%s
:::

::: {.bml-project-body}
%s
:::
:::
', mdEscape(r$Name), projectAnchor(r$Name),
    if (nzchar(meta)) sprintf("\n::: {.bml-project-meta}\n%s\n:::\n", meta) else "",
    dropRetired(r$Summary))
}

## the projects in each group
groupRows <- function(g) {
  if (is.na(g$type)) projects[Primary == 0] else projects[Primary == 1 & Type == g$type]
}
shown <- Filter(function(g) is.na(g$type) || nrow(groupRows(g)) > 0, groups)
```

```{=html}
<!-- Raw HTML: markdown can't add behaviour. On phones and tablets the navbar's
     Projects menu stays open after a project on this page is picked, so the
     jump lands behind the open menu, and closing it then moves the page up
     past the project. So: close the menu first, then jump. (Desktop, where the
     menu isn't collapsed, and links to other pages are left alone.) It sits
     here, not at the end, so the page still ends with a band (styles/bml.scss
     then joins the last band to the footer). -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var a = e.target.closest('#navbarCollapse a[href*="#"]:not([data-bs-toggle])');
  var menu = document.getElementById('navbarCollapse');
  var page = function (p) { return p.replace(/\.html$/, ''); };
  var button = document.querySelector('.navbar-toggler[data-bs-target="#navbarCollapse"]');
  if (!a || !a.hash || page(a.pathname) !== page(location.pathname) ||
      !menu || !menu.classList.contains('show') || !button) return;
  var target = document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(a.hash.slice(1)));
  if (!target) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  menu.addEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', function () {
    // wait for Quarto to shrink the page's top padding to the closed navbar
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (location.hash === a.hash) target.scrollIntoView();
      else location.hash = a.hash;
    }, 50);
  }, { once: true });
  // close it with the menu button, as a reader would: the button's onclick
  // (Quarto's) also lets the navbar hide on scroll again
  button.click();
});
</script>
```

::: {.column-screen .bml-band .bml-projects-intro}
[From clinical trials to studies of daily life, these are the studies our lab runs and the projects we work on with other research teams.]{.bml-projects-lead}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

## jump list: one chip per group on the page
cat("::: {.bml-chips .bml-projects-jump}\n",
    paste(vapply(shown, function(g) sprintf("[%s](#%s){.bml-chip}", g$title, g$id), ""),
          collapse = "\n"),
    "\n:::\n", sep = "")
```
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

## one day band per group: heading row (title left, a line about the group
## right, hairline above), then a card per project. Groups of our own with no
## projects are left out; "Projects we collaborate on" always shows, as the
## navbar links to it.
for (g in shown) {
  rows <- groupRows(g)
  cards <- if (nrow(rows) > 0) {
    paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) projectMd(rows[i]), ""), collapse = "\n")
  } else {
    "::: {.bml-card .bml-project}\nNone listed at the moment.\n:::\n"
  }
  cat(sprintf('
::: {.column-screen .bml-band .bml-projects-band}
::: {.grid .bml-gap-lg .bml-projects-head}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5}
## %s {#%s}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7}
%s
:::
:::

::: {.bml-projects-list}
%s
:::
:::
', g$title, g$id, g$about, cards))
}
```
